cards.head: Canada's prime minister has set up a national council to advise on making AI safer.
cards.body: Mark Carney named AI researcher Yoshua Bengio and others to advise on strategy and safety. It only gives advice, and its powers, budget and start date are not yet known.

report_refs.excerpt: Canada's government has a new national council on AI, set up by Prime Minister Mark Carney to advise on strategy and on making the technology safer.

cards.head: Robot software start-up FieldAI is reportedly raising $700 million from investors.
cards.body: The deal would make the robot software maker worth five times its value last year. It rests on one unnamed source, and the deal may not have closed yet.

report_refs.excerpt: Business Insider reports that robotics startup FieldAI is raising $700 million in a deal valuing it at $10 billion, about five times its value a little over a year ago.

cards.cat: Market, industry and finance / Stock market
cards.head: Nvidia's shares touched a record price on Friday for the first time since May.
cards.body: Investors came back after a summer slump wiped over a trillion dollars off its value. The gain shrank by the close, and the shares ended just below the May record.

report_refs.excerpt: Nvidia's share price briefly set a new record on Friday 2 October, then ended the day just below its May high as investors returned after a two-month slump.

cards.cat: Market, industry and finance / AI prices
cards.head: US companies now use far more AI than in July yet pay less for it.
cards.body: Spending tracker Ramp says AI use rose by about half since July while bills fell. Its economist puts that down to OpenAI and Anthropic undercutting each other on price.

report_refs.excerpt: Ramp says US companies are spending less on AI than in July even as their use has risen about 50%, a drop its economist links to OpenAI and Anthropic competing on price.

cards.head: Apple will make it harder for Mac apps to read everything on your computer.
cards.body: Apple says AI agents make such access riskier, so users must give very clear permission. It has not said what the new controls are or when they start.

report_refs.excerpt: Apple said it will make it harder for Mac apps to get 'Full Disk Access', because AI agents make that level of access riskier.

cards.head: An AI-copied voice and a fake WhatsApp text reportedly fooled an Italian banker.
cards.body: Italian bank Fideuram's former president was tricked in February into sending about 95 million euros. Much was recovered, but at least 36 million euros are still missing, a newspaper reports.

report_refs.excerpt: A former president of the Italian bank Fideuram was reportedly tricked by a fake WhatsApp message and an AI-copied voice into sending about 95 million euros, and at least 36 million euros are still missing.

cards.head: Samsung reportedly wants over triple today's price for its next AI memory chips.
cards.body: This is next year's newer version of the memory that sits beside AI processors. The figure is a proposal in ongoing talks, not a signed contract price.

report_refs.excerpt: Samsung is reportedly asking customers to pay more than three times as much for its new HBM4 AI memory next year as for the current HBM3E version.

cards.head: An Oracle data center in Wisconsin may soon run partly on nuclear power.
cards.body: We Energies would let Oracle take up to a fifth of a nuclear plant's electricity. Regulators must approve it, and the utility says other customers would save on fuel costs.

report_refs.excerpt: Wisconsin utility We Energies has struck a deal to send part of a nuclear plant's electricity to an Oracle data center, if state regulators approve.

cards.head: The Pentagon may add up to 50 robot boats to patrol the Rio Grande border.
cards.body: Ten canoe-sized, solar-powered boats already patrol the river and can stay out for months. It says they help catch hundreds a month, but the expansion is only under study.

report_refs.excerpt: The Pentagon is considering adding as many as 50 small robot boats to the 10 it already uses to watch the Rio Grande for illegal crossings.

cards.head: Meta opened up its Muse AI so hobbyists can build their own gadgets around it.
cards.body: The free code wires Muse, Meta's new AI assistant, to homemade screens, buttons and sensors. Meta also gives away 5,000 home-control boxes but warns builders: proceed at your own risk.

report_refs.excerpt: Meta has released free code so that people can build their own gadgets that run its new AI assistant, Muse.

cards.head: Meta says its Muse chatbot helped mathematicians crack five unsolved problems.
cards.body: The chatbot suggested proofs and examples, and named mathematicians then checked and corrected them. No outside review is reported, and other teams independently found some of the answers.

report_refs.excerpt: Meta says mathematicians working with its Muse Spark chatbot have found answers to five research questions that were still open.

cards.head: An appeals court froze Minnesota's law against AI-made fake nude pictures, for now.
cards.body: Elon Musk's AI firm xAI won the pause while it sues, calling the law unconstitutional. It was America's first such ban, and a lower court had refused xAI last month.

report_refs.excerpt: A US appeals court has put Minnesota's ban on AI-made fake nude images on hold while Elon Musk's xAI argues in a lawsuit that the law is unconstitutional.

cards.head: Fewer patients died after 11 hospitals let an AI warning call the emergency team.
cards.body: Deaths among high-risk adults fell by about a fifth once the alerts began, researchers report. The study only compared two periods, so the alerts may not be the cause.

report_refs.excerpt: Researchers report that deaths among high-risk hospital patients were lower after 11 hospitals began using an AI risk score to alert rapid response teams automatically.

cards.head: Pope Leo says telling human art apart from machine-made work is becoming urgent.
cards.body: He wrote on X that machines just calculate from millions of images other people made. He added that 'algorithms lack the spark of humanity', an opinion rather than a rule.

report_refs.excerpt: Pope Leo XIV said on social media that human art is different in kind from what machines make and that it is becoming urgent to tell the two apart.

cards.head: An Airbnb guest on Reddit says a host's $1,700 toilet-flood 'proof' was an AI photo.
cards.body: Google's Gemini chatbot spotted its own hidden watermark in the photo, the post says. The bill was rejected, the guest adds, though it all rests on one unconfirmed post.

report_refs.excerpt: An Airbnb host in Australia reportedly tried to charge a guest $1,700 for a flooded toilet, using a picture that appears to be AI-made.

entries.head: A market to buy and sell AI computing power in advance is reportedly coming.

report_refs.excerpt: The Financial Times says a market where people can trade contracts on future AI computing power is on its way.

entries.head: China's buying spree at chip-tool maker ASML reportedly spurs US calls for a total ban.

report_refs.excerpt: Heavy Chinese buying of ASML's DUV chip-making machines has led to calls in the US for a total ban on selling them to China, the South China Morning Post reports.

entries.head: Alibaba's free Qwen AI steers clear of topics China's rulers dislike, a start-up says.

report_refs.excerpt: An Israeli security startup says Alibaba's free Qwen AI model dodges questions or gives government-friendly answers on topics that China's authorities dislike.

entries.head: The US added only 29,000 jobs in September, and more employers blame AI for cuts.

report_refs.excerpt: US employers added just 29,000 jobs in September, well short of what economists expected, while more companies say AI is behind their job cuts.

cards.head: AI is getting cheaper to use but may cost more to build, and banks are stepping in.
cards.body: Businesses pay less to use AI, while banks reportedly arrange a $60 billion chip loan. Watch whether it closes: that shows if lenders still back AI chips.

report_refs.excerpt: Banks working with Broadcom have reportedly started gathering $60 billion of financing to pay for AI chips for Anthropic and other companies.
Nvidia's share price briefly set a new record on Friday 2 October, then ended the day just below its May high as investors returned after a two-month slump.
Ramp says US companies are spending less on AI than in July even as their use has risen about 50%, a drop its economist links to OpenAI and Anthropic competing on price.
